title: pilorea graminifolia
intro: Pilorea graminifolia, commonly known as the grass-leaf pilorea, is a plant species in the family Apocynaceae. This plant has been studied for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Pilorea graminifolia include its ability to act as an anti-oxidant, anti-inflammatory and potentially anti-cancer agent. The bioactive constituents of Pilorea graminifolia include alkaloids, phenolic compounds, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
